methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional capacity-building in a non-metro region, signaling potential for distributed deep learning if the lab creates sustained peer networks beyond initial leadership training.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native directly target the distribution dimension, though sustainability and depth depend on whether participants build ongoing learning communities or receive one-time exposure.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates institutional resources and expertise in the capital region, potentially deepening Richmond's capability hub while the community impact language suggests aspirations toward broader distribution that remain unproven.

signals.title: Richmond summer program helps visually impaired students explore careers in technology and cybersecurity - WTVR.com
signals.signal_reading: A specialized program bringing visually impaired students into tech careers demonstrates intentional inclusion work that could broaden the base of AI-capable workers, though small scale limits immediate distributional impact.

signals.title: Tech Briefs: Virginia Tech adds an artificial intelligence minor to its curriculum - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's new AI minor adds academic depth in the New River Valley, but university-centered credentialing tends to concentrate expertise rather than distribute it unless paired with community extension programs.
